formulas.formula: Build your safety net, one deposit at a time.
Setup: your name, how many months of expenses you want saved (3 to 6 is common) and your monthly saving plan.
Essentials: the bills you must pay even in a bad month. This sets your goal.
Accounts: where your fund lives, with each starting balance and interest rate.
Log: every deposit, withdrawal (when you use it) and interest payment.
Dashboard: saved, goal, months covered and the date you'll be fully funded.
Count needs, not wants. Skip eating out and subscriptions.
Using the fund is what it's for. Log it, then rebuild.
A high-yield savings account: safe, separate, and easy to reach.
Always type positive amounts. Pick the Type to say in or out.
Red means something needs a look.

=IF('Setup'!$R$11<=0,"Add your essentials to set a goal.",IF(R4=0,"Fully funded. You did it!",IF(R6<1,"Getting started. Every deposit counts.",IF(R6<3,"Good start. You can cover a surprise bill.","Strong. You could ride out "&INT(R6)&" months."))))
What you can add each month.
Must-pay bills for one month. Your goal is this total times your months.
Where your fund lives. Starting balance = what was there before your first Log entry.
Every move in or out. Amounts are always positive; the Type says which way.
